purpose: Concrete, adequately-powered preregistration skeleton for the first trigger-gated advance. Must be instantiated as a NEW prereg file with a specific estimand, source audit, and frozen timestamp BEFORE any outcome inspection when a resume trigger fires.

non_overlapping_30d_test_blocks.rationale: claim-worthiness / block-bootstrap stability per RESEARCH_PROMPT and program precedent

required_minima.mde_target: target MDE (80% power, alpha=0.05, two-sided) MUST be below the 2% materiality floor for the primary contrast given realistic event counts/variance; compute and document MDE before freeze from pilot variance only if permitted, else justify conservatively from historical sealed estimates

inference.bootstrap: paired block bootstrap over complete UTC-day (or prereg-specified) blocks

multiplicity.correction: Holm (or stronger preregistered FWER control) across the full registered contrast family

instantiation_checklist: Assign unique experiment_id and UTC timestamp; create research_state/session_<UTC>/ (do not add root md/json if root near cap).
Write §16 admissibility/source audit artifact for any new data (unauthenticated, provenance, license/terms, coverage, gaps) BEFORE prereg freeze/outcomes.
Define estimand, outcome, universe, features (causal/as-of), baselines, primary contrast, and materially-different rationale vs all terminal cells.
Freeze train/val/test with embargo, block definitions, and sample-size/MDE justification.
Set outcome_data_inspected_before_freeze=true/false honestly at freeze (must be false for confirmatory).
Register any new scripts in BOTH scope registries (drift green) before claiming completion.
Run evaluation + gates; emit evaluation_summary and leakage/data-integrity notes; update frontier/hypothesis registries with honest verdict.
Never promote without meeting all preregistered gate criteria; preserve null/inconclusive results.
notes: H2_shek_replication remains EXPLORATORY_ONLY (promotable=false). Track A forward progress requires admissible observed-liquidation data/labels; Track B sealed NOT_SUPPORTED; Track C terminal on cached confirmatory designs per frontier/power synthesis.
